scripts.test: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm --filter frontend icons:check && pnpm --filter frontend locales:check && pnpm build
scripts.data:hotspots: cd backend && uv run python -m app.pipelines.fetch_hotspots
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --project backend && (git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true)
scripts.data:zones: cd backend && uv run python -m app.pipelines.fetch_zones
scripts.data:spread: cd backend && uv run python -m app.pipelines.build_spread
scripts.data:lead-time: cd backend && uv run python -m app.pipelines.build_lead_time
scripts.data:routes: cd backend && uv run python -m app.pipelines.cache_routes
scripts.eval:triage: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest tests/eval_triage.py -v
scripts.check:routes: cd backend && uv run python -m app.pipelines.check_routes
scripts.voice:goodbye: cd backend && uv run python -m app.pipelines.set_goodbye
scripts.voice:deploy: cd voice/resident && set -a && . ../../.env && set +a && unmute deploy && cd ../coordinator && unmute deploy && cd ../.. && pnpm voice:goodbye
